snippet.title: Netherwake Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
#Netherwake #HorrorGame #IndieHorror #PsychologicalHorror #LovecraftianHorror

Prepare to enter the nightmare—Netherwake is an upcoming first-person psychological horror game from NALYCAN, creators of the YouTube-loved The Mare of Jonah. In this official reveal trailer, get your first look at a haunting world inspired by the cosmic dread of H.P. Lovecraft, where an unnatural fog has swallowed your town and sanity is your most fragile resource. Designed for fans of story-rich horror, stealth gameplay, and tension-filled survival, Netherwake puts you and your loyal dog in a twisted fight against both monstrous invaders and your crumbling mind. Whether you're a horror game YouTuber or a thrill-seeking gamer, don’t miss this early glimpse into the terror that awaits in 2026.

Don't forget to visit the official Netherwake Steam page and add it to your wishlist — it helps us out a lot and ensures you won't miss any updates before launch!:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3652920/Netherwake/

Check out other videos from NALYCAN to see what’s coming next in the world of indie horror:
https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLMNvfmrNUZkBb5r6QN-BjbBQ_znbi97Kj&si=Y-lE-ohG7v7A1Xmp
